title: Whole ReLiC lifecycle
goal: Keep ReLiC whole across Remember, Exist, Live, Imagine, Create, and Share; no demonstration or subsystem may redefine ReLiC as only one duty.
next: surface lifecycle status in ReLiC Share

title: Remember continuity evidence
goal: Preserve errors, corrections, canon, authority/law records, successes, known-working references, backups, provenance, decisions, and why changes occurred without promoting history into current authority.
next: prevent silent deletion of superseded evidence

title: Exist as continual reference
goal: Resolve applicable ReLiC authority, provenance, time, known errors, and context before dependent downstream actions proceed; never convert missing or conflicting authority into permission.

title: Live environmental observation
goal: Observe the current hackathon environment through authorized interfaces while keeping historical readings distinct from current environmental identity.
next: connect authorized AMD interfaces when available

title: Imagine and test hypotheses
goal: Test truth versus hypothesis/fiction without promoting plausibility to fact; preserve known, evidence, inference, hypothesis, test, and result as distinguishable states.

title: Create authority-following reports
goal: Create traceable context/report packages that AI, humans, and authorized connectors can follow without losing authority, provenance, uncertainty, errors, tests, or results.

title: Share ReLiC with AMD
goal: Expose ReLiC's hackathon implementation and proof to AMD. Share is a proof window into ReLiC, not a replacement for ReLiC.

title: Authority resolution
goal: Resolve applicable authority records without converting plans or model outputs into authority.
next: surface unresolved authority conflicts for human review

title: Change and recovery continuity
goal: Preserve why a change happened and maintain evidence of known-working states.
next: link failures to corrections and working references
prevent silent deletion of superseded evidence

title: RuneCore structured meaning
goal: Represent evidence, authority, intent, relationships, and execution boundaries in a stable structure without inventing authority.
next: map demo policy records into runes
build deterministic authority trace before model inference

title: AMD inference and environmental integration
goal: Run verified AMD-backed inference and test Environmental Intelligence through event-authorized AMD interfaces while preserving ReLiC evidence context.

title: Evolus workflow integration
goal: Execute or escalate hackathon business workflows using verified Evolus building blocks without letting workflow state overwrite authority history.
next: select at least two required building blocks
